info.title: SpecTrace: Spec-Driven Development traceability for .NET
info.description: The SpecTrace CLI (dotnet spectrace): traceability report, spec change review (spectrace.lock), MCP server for AI coding agents, import from Spec Kit and OpenSpec, and xUnit test scaffolding.

commands.name: context
commands.description: Requirement context for an agent: statement, criteria, status and how to mark the work.

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Creates spectrace.json, specs/example.spec.md, the agent skill and .mcp.json.
--skills-dir <dir> skills folder (default .claude/skills)

commands.name: lock
commands.description:
Records the current version of the spec as reviewed (spectrace.lock).
--requirement <ID> only that requirement (repeatable); without it, all active ones
--check            does not write: exit code 1 if there are unreviewed changes

commands.name: mcp
commands.description:
MCP server over stdio for agents (Claude Code, VS Code, Agent Framework...). import speckit Imports GitHub Spec Kit specs (a spec.md or a specs/ folder). --prefix

ID prefix (default: initials of the feature, e.g. PA1) --out output (single feature only); default spectrace.spec.md next to the source import openspec Imports OpenSpec specs (openspec/, openspec/specs or a spec.md). --prefix

ID prefix (default: the capability name, e.g. AUTH) --out output (single capability only); default /.spec.md Common: --status approved|proposed (status of imported items with criteria), --dry-run

commands.name: report
commands.description:
Requirement → code → test matrix.
--format md|json|github
md by default; github = GitHub Actions annotations
--link-base <url>  prefix for absolute links in md (PR comments)
--out <file>       write to a file instead of the console
--fail-on-gaps     exit code 1 if active requirements are not implemented or not tested
--fail-on-drift    exit code 1 if there are unreviewed spec changes (spectrace.lock)

commands.name: scaffold-tests
commands.description:
xUnit skeletons for criteria without tests.
--project <dir>    folder of the test project (required)
--requirement <ID> only that requirement
--namespace <ns>   root namespace of the test project

commands.name: stories
commands.description:
User stories of the tracker and the requirements that come from each one.
--label <name>     default: trackers.github.label in spectrace.json ("user-story"); "" = all
--state open|closed|all
--unspecified      only stories that no requirement cites yet
--fail-on-unspecified
exit code 1 if a listed story has no requirement
--format md|json

commands.name: story
commands.description:
A user story from the issue tracker (GitHub Issues) and the requirements that cite it.
<ref>              #12, owner/repo#12 or the issue URL
--format md|json
